title: Oracle momentum
description: How the oracle price has moved over the last minute, five minutes and hour. Direction is the sign of the five-minute return.

return_bps_1m.label: Return 1m
return_bps_1m.description: The change in the oracle price over the last minute, in basis points. Positive means the price has been rising.

return_bps_5m.label: Return 5m
return_bps_5m.description: The change in the oracle price over the last five minutes, in basis points. The window most fifteen-minute rounds care about.

return_bps_1h.label: Return 1h
return_bps_1h.description: The change in the oracle price over the last hour, in basis points. The slow trend behind the shorter reads.

direction_5m.label: Move direction 5m
direction_5m.description: Up or down once the five-minute return clears a small threshold, otherwise flat. The one-word version of the return.
